brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage exceeding one quarter of the free area and clear any obstruction before the forecast heat event, as outlined in SOP-015. For Camden Works 230/34kV, which has an ONAN cooling type, apply ambient de-rating based on average ambient temperatures as specified in MG-021. Furthermore, on events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply the further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward in accordance with MG-021.
